execution.source_step_sha256_reason: No .step or .stp asset currently exists under vesselforge; the one-shot runner creates and hashes the STEP only after export.

findings.title: Exported station aggregator trusts terminal BOUND rows
findings.description: bind_stations_to_parent_mesh is exported and copies any input row already marked BOUND without validating station identity, geometry, arrays, or parent_mesh_content_hash. If every row is so marked, it returns PASS_MOTHER_STATION_BINDING. A single {station_id: x, status: BOUND} row can pass with malformed arrays and a fabricated hash. The production build_wall_mesh_binding path validates the package/reference and creates its own rows before aggregation, so this is the separately exported low-level API surface.
findings.recommendation: Keep the aggregator private or validate terminal rows/provenance before allowing them to contribute to top-level PASS.

findings.title: Boolean tessellation targets are accepted as numeric policy values
findings.description: _load_binding_policy converts each provenance/report value with float() and has no bool rejection. Matching JSON true values convert to 1.0, pass the positivity/equality checks, and produce a 1.0000201 mm linear projection limit and 15 degree normal-angle limit. This can admit a malformed package with a much looser budget than intended. validate_asset does not strictly type-check these provenance tessellation fields.
findings.recommendation: Reject booleans and non-numeric JSON types before conversion; add finite/positive/type validation to BindingPolicy construction if exported low-level functions remain public.
